name: io.github.youbotapi/gpt-image-mcp
description: Generate and edit images with GPT Image 2.5 for $0.029 — free key, 50 credits, no card.

environmentVariables.name: YOUBOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from you.bot — NOT an OpenAI key. Free at https://you.bot, 50 credits (~17 images) on signup, no credit card. Keys start with sk-live-.

environmentVariables.name: YOUBOT_IMAGE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. If set, every generated image is also saved to this folder.
